title: Two Sum
description: Given an array of integers nums and an integer target, return indices of the two numbers such that they add up to target. You may not use the same element twice.

expected_approaches.name: hash_map
expected_approaches.summary: Iterate once and store previous values in a hash map from value to index.

title: Valid Parentheses
description: Given a string s containing only parentheses characters, determine if the input string is valid. Open brackets must be closed by the same type and in the correct order.

examples.explanation: Every opening bracket is closed correctly.
The bracket types do not match.

expected_approaches.name: stack
expected_approaches.summary: Push opening brackets, and check each closing bracket against the top of the stack.

common_mistakes.description: 遇到右括号时没有先判断栈是否为空
遍历结束后没有检查栈是否为空

title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock
description: Given an array prices where prices[i] is the price of a stock on day i, choose one day to buy and a later day to sell to maximize profit.

expected_approaches.name: track_min_price
expected_approaches.summary: Track the lowest price seen so far and update the best profit for each day.

common_mistakes.description: 使用 O(n^2) 枚举所有买卖日

title: Binary Search
description: Given a sorted array of integers nums and an integer target, return the index of target if it exists, otherwise return -1.
constraints: nums is sorted in ascending order

expected_approaches.name: binary_search
expected_approaches.summary: Maintain left and right boundaries and discard half of the search interval each iteration.

common_mistakes.description: left <= right 和 left < right 的边界混用
mid 或边界更新导致越界

title: Maximum Subarray
description: Given an integer array nums, find the subarray with the largest sum and return its sum.

expected_approaches.name: kadane
expected_approaches.summary: Track the best subarray ending at the current index and the global best sum.

common_mistakes.description: 没有定义清楚 dp[i] 表示以 i 结尾的最大和

title: Climbing Stairs
description: You are climbing a staircase. Each time you can climb 1 or 2 steps. Given n, return how many distinct ways you can climb to the top.

expected_approaches.name: fibonacci_dp
expected_approaches.summary: The number of ways to reach step n equals ways(n - 1) + ways(n - 2).

common_mistakes.description: n = 1 或 n = 2 初始化错误

title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
description: Given a string s, find the length of the longest substring without repeating characters.

expected_approaches.name: sliding_window
expected_approaches.summary: Move the right boundary through the string and update the left boundary when a repeated character appears.

common_mistakes.description: 左边界回退或更新不及时

title: Number of Islands
description: Given an m x n grid of '1' and '0', return the number of islands. An island is surrounded by water and connected horizontally or vertically.

expected_approaches.name: dfs_mark_visited
expected_approaches.summary: Scan the grid. When land is found, count one island and DFS/BFS to mark all connected land.

common_mistakes.description: 没有及时标记 visited，导致重复访问
